# Final Critique and Thirty Additional Improvements

The Awtsmoos reveals the missing edge before the blade can stray;
Awtsmoos.com keeps every correction recorded on the way.

1. Begin with shared definitions that existing catalogs can consume incrementally.
2. Avoid static import of optional effect families in the fallback bootstrap.
3. Preserve current action IDs to avoid save and network breakage.
4. Add aliases only through one migration table.
5. Validate Hebrew names and English translations as required fields.
6. Keep element and affinity IDs lowercase and stable.
7. Make diagnostic ordering deterministic for snapshot tests.
8. Clamp every numeric multiplier and duration.
9. Make immunity explicit rather than encoded as zero damage alone.
10. Treat critical interaction as a labeled rule, not a random critical hit.
11. Distinguish guard damage, stagger damage, interrupt force, and health damage.
12. Distinguish poise from concentration so melee and casting remain readable.
13. Reset interrupt resistance only through explicit cast lifecycle transitions.
14. Use cast-instance IDs to reject stale completion after reconnect.
15. Include action version in authoritative receipts.
16. Keep server insight payloads independent from private resistance records.
17. Make Daas tiers monotonic and test each disclosure boundary.
18. Preserve existing equipment-derived legacy damage and defense.
19. Add affinity-derived mechanics without universal multipliers.
20. Record status source, source action, source actor, application time, and expiry.
21. Apply cleanse rules before new status reactions when ordering matters.
22. Define deterministic reaction precedence for burn, soak, grounding, and illumination.
23. Keep active status collections keyed and bounded.
24. Use compact snapshots for multiplayer interest updates.
25. Keep local authority in a separate adapter, not conditionals scattered through gameplay.
26. Add world-state tags through a narrow environment context provider.
27. Treat accessibility text as required presentation data.
28. Treat effect cancellation as part of cast cancellation tests.
29. Measure initial bundle inclusion after every new import boundary.
30. Delay full catalog expansion until the first vertical slice proves identity, authority, UI, and cleanup.

## Final revelation

The implementation must not attempt the entire content matrix before proving the canonical machinery. The first production pass will establish the shared domain, enrich current action catalogs, provide authoritative effectiveness and status receipts, and create tests. Further enemy, HUD, effect, persistence, loading, and browser work will then extend the same truth without replacement.
